name: Home Stakeholder And AI Workbench Prototype
scenario: Understand who expects each task, who must act next, and what AI is doing.
visualQaTasks: Confirm requester, assignee, waiting-on, AI status, and next action are distinguishable on every task card.
Confirm attention counters behave like filters instead of decorative metrics.
Confirm AI completed is represented as waiting for human review, not task done.
Confirm the active AI rail disappears when its state is empty.
Confirm long task and organization names wrap without pushing the primary action.
Confirm mobile order is attention, work items, then active AI.
